title: Boston Sailing Center

services.name: US Sailing
services.desc: As a member of the Boston Sailing Center, you’ll enjoy more time on the water than most boat owners - and at far less cost. Membership entitles you to unlimited sailing during the regular season with no additional cost for boat usage. The Center’s low member-to-boat ratio ensures optimal boat availability throughout the season. And our proven record of excellent boat maintenance is second to none. Learn to Sail Course or Equivalent Experience and on-the-Water Checkout and Navigation Test. Before purchasing a membership, please review Policies and Procedures and Membership Cancellation Policies. For information on how membership at Boston Sailing Center works, please visit our Membership

services.name: Boston Charters
services.desc: Are you looking for an exciting alternative to golf or sightseeing for your group? Experience the beauty and excitement of Boston Harbor in a way few people can. Whether you seek a relaxing seaside outing or a serious team building experience, Boston Sailing Center can customize the perfect sailing event for your organization. With over forty years of experience on boats ranging from twenty-four to forty feet, Boston Sailing Center is well equipped to satisfy your needs. Our staff is experienced in working with adults of all sailing abilities and teaches several hundred students each year.
